suite: Bounded 1Hz display feed / YMCC width policy
originalScope: Deterministic production TS logic, virtual monotonic clock, no hardware/runtime
expectedNames: No-subscriber updates allocate no timer, store latest only
Initial unavailable cache does not delay first real sample
10000 duplicates cause no pending timer or extra display
Burst keeps one timer/one value, flushes latest at 1000ms without catch-up
An early browser timer cannot spend the next sample budget prematurely
Continuous 100Hz input cannot publish ordinary samples faster than 1Hz
Health-down invalidates immediately, cannot reset recovery sample-rate budget
Late display receives latest cache, no extra broadcast to existing display
Last unsubscribe cancels pending timer; inactive owner never wakes
Dispose stops future values/subscriptions and removes timer
Bad display listener cannot break other consumers
900px baseline is monitor-only; all other YMCC routes retain 580px
1920×1080: original height zoom, no compression, 755px logical content
1280×720: original height zoom, no compression, 755px logical content
DPR2 reference remains uncompressed at supported physical resolutions
Feed key covers session/sequence/health and per-field freshness, not costly JSON snapshots
